description:
At the beginning of combat, Mishra triggers, creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform.
When Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, it and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger twice each, causing you to get eight {E}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying eight {E} and exiling it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
